sources.entry: spicetify-cli - Command-line tool to customize the official Spotify client. Supports Windows, MacOS and Linux.

summary.one_liner: Spicetify CLI is a command-line tool that customizes the official Spotify desktop client by changing colors, injecting CSS, extensions, and custom apps.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and only describes high-level features. It says the tool changes colors across the Spotify user interface, injects CSS for deeper styling, and injects extensions that can extend functionality, manipulate the UI, and control the player. It can also inject custom apps. The README states it supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It links to installation and basic usage sections, but those details are not included in the provided text. A code signing policy note says Windows builds are signed for free through SignPath.io.
use_cases: theme Spotify on Windows, macOS, or Linux
how_to_run: See the Installation and Basic Usage sections linked from the README (not included in the provided text)
notable: Injects CSS, extensions, and custom apps into the official Spotify client
Windows builds use free code signing via SignPath.io
caveats: Installation and usage steps are not included in the provided README text; linked sections were not available
Modifies the official Spotify client, so changes depend on that client's internals
